text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know... Air Shakur tried really
hard. I'll
give her that.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
But her performance was a bit of a
letdown. Sure
would be nice if some
heavy hitters with actual
promise showed
up at some point.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The disparity in skill between Air Shakur
and the
senior-year racers became
evident at the Japan
Cup, turning the
public's opinion on her on its
head.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
My opinion on Air Shakur? Well... I think
she's
great. She's a cut above the rest for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She's certainly strong, if we only go by
her track
record, but... well, can we
really take those
records at face value?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
There aren't very many strong racers in
her year,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
If she had a powerful rival to contend
with, then
there'd be no doubt that she's
the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Usually, there are no shortages of rivals
pitting
their dreams and tenacity against
each other in
heated battle...

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Strangely enough, such rivalries are
missing this
time around. I did see a few
potential
contenders... but perhaps they
couldn't pull
through in time.

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
It seems the consensus is that she was
lucky... And
if you're listening, Air
Shakur, don't forget to
wave to your fans
every once in a while!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Ahaha—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't turn it off.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no need. I figured it'd be like
this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
My achievements may score high on an
absolute
scale, but that doesn't make
them exempt from
people's subjective
scrutiny.
choice_data_list: Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Numbers are the only absolute things in
this
world. However...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's not good if things are too absolute.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae has shown me my fate: I'll never
be able to
win again.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever route I take or pattern I
attempt to
implement, I keep endin' up
back here.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Guess that's why it's called fate...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's not much time left till the spring
Tenno
Sho, so why waste it worryin'
about background
noise?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no point fussin' over every
complaint or
opinion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur isn't being completely honest
right
now. She's not one to mince words
when she truly
doesn't care about
something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her, things are never left to
ambiguous
interpretation. She's strict
and honest with
herself, and she's a
strong person who doesn't let
other
people's opinions sway her.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: (Let's go after her. I need to hear it in her own words.)

text_block_list.text:
The representative of the "weakest
generation"
may stand above the rest in
her year, but she's
still weak.
>System.InvalidOperation

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up. Buzz off already.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ugh. I knew you'd show up.
choice_data_list: Shakur.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I get the feelin' the gods are toyin' with
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You don't think so? Despite how
ridiculous this
is?
choice_data_list: God?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Everything's gone just as predicted. And despite knowing that, I've been busting my ass trying to change the inevitable. Someone upstairs has got to be laughin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I know what they're sayin'. "Give up.
Quit acting
like this. Change your ways.
Accept your fate.
Then you might find
salvation."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Even my own partner's been tryin' to rile
me up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's the only answer I'll accept.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've built up a track record of absolute
values...
Anyone can see that plain as
day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And yet, not a single person's evaluated
me fairly.
Why? Because of the year I'm
in? 'Cause I don't
have a proper rival?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No. It's 'cause I'm me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sight of Air Shakur looking so
hopeless and
helpless causes me to blurt
out my next words
before I have the
chance to think.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Did nothing really change at all?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Did your feelings stay the same, too?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Stop beatin' around the bush. What do
you want
from me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then she should know the path she
chose isn't
wrong. The first thing is for
her to accept that
fact. But that's not all.
choice_data_list: If you truly believe in the numbers...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: You should take pride in yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've watched her get to this point.
Despite being
plagued with nightmares
throughout the Classic
Triple Crown, she
overcame her fate.
choice_data_list: I'm not your âpartner,â but...
I may not be your "partner," but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And despite her fear of the
insurmountable wall
blocking her way,
she didn't shrink from the
challenge. She
never stopped thinking either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That is the truth. I've witnessed all her

accomplishments with my own eyes, and
as her
trainer, there is one thing I can
say.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: You're the strongest. That reality won't change for me.
You're the strongest. But my reality doesn't change.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.
choice_data_list: No matter which route we took, I'm confident I would've told you the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're an overoptimistic fool... I'm weak.
I
wouldn't have been able to change my
fate on my
own.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It took interference from an
unquantifiable
influence—from you.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How the hell am I supposed to take
pride in that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she honestly believes she couldn't
have done it
by herself, she's made a
grave miscalculation.
choice_data_list: That's wrong!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: It was your sheer grit that changed destiny.
It was your sheer grit that changed destiny.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur is fixated on winning. The
reason why I
signed on to be her trainer
was because her
perseverance resonated
with me—and she
accepted.
choice_data_list: Because it's you, I chose this place.
It's because of you that I chose this place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I helped her in some way, that's her
merit for
choosing her trainer effectively.
And even if I
managed to make a
difference...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She came so far on her own—a mere
beat of a
butterfly's wings was the last
push she needed.
From the moment she
chose to overturn her fate...
choice_data_list: To reach 1, you needed 0.99.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You're so naive.
choice_data_list: Fate had already changed on that very day.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're always givin' the same worthless
pep talks.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I guess that's your own brand of
tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever. I see where you're coming
from.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What's that supposed to mean?
choice_data_list: Let's teach Shakur a lesson too.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
choice_data_list: Let's make them all see your stubborn pride.
Let's make them all see your stubborn pride.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Are you being serious?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.
choice_data_list: I'm always serious.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's right. That's who you are, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You've always been like that. No need
to run any
analyses to see that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: My tenacity, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Still... At the end of the day, I couldn't
do it on
my own.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No, I've come this far by myself. If I'm
gonna
trust this idiot, then the only
thing I can do is
prove myself.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm the only one who can raise myself up.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I'm nothing in people's eyes, then I'll
just force
'em to look this way.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'll make every last one of 'em
understand me.
Hmph, that's such an
abstract and ambiguous
goal. But still...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to do this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm? Parcae?

> Start initialization process?
>[y]:

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What's with this command?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Reinitialization? Are you trying to get
me to reset
you back to a fresh install?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I don't need you becoming
self-aware
outta nowhere like some
kinda sci-fi story... The
heck, though? I
didn't code this...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I guess you want me to create my own
reality.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That's right. The two of us are different.
